feature_title: Logs Saved View Build Mode Restore

rationale.edition: All four changed paths (web/src/plugins/logs/SearchBar.vue, web/src/plugins/logs/BuildQueryPage.vue, web/src/composables/dashboard/useDashboardPanel.ts, web/src/utils/logs/constants.ts) live under web/src/ — the open-source frontend. None are under enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/, or any enterprise-gated module, and no enterprise-only keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/sensitive-data) appear in the paths or symbols, so this is an OSS change.
rationale.skip: Not skipping. There is no tests-added label, no skip request in trigger_comment.txt, and the diff is not docs/CI/comment-only — it changes real UI behavior in web/src, so it is user-facing.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted: applying a saved view from the logs page now hands the saved builder chart (stream, fields, joins, chart type, config) to the build tab and repoints the URL's build_data, instead of re-deriving the builder from the logs query. This is a user-exercisable flow (open logs → configure build mode → save view → re-apply → verify the builder restores exactly).
rationale.area: Area is Logs. The bulk of the changes are in web/src/plugins/logs/ (SearchBar.vue and BuildQueryPage.vue), and the sibling specs (logsQueryBuilder.spec.js, shareLink.spec.js) live in tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Logs/.
rationale.group: playwright_group is Logs-Features: the closest existing matrix group whose run_files hold the build-mode/saved-config feature specs (logsQueryBuilder.spec.js, shareLink.spec.js) all mapping to actual_folder Logs.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff — only frontend source files (web/src/**/*.vue and *.ts) were changed; nothing under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/ is present, so there is no existing Playwright coverage to enhance.
